record.question: She refused to wear the new dress as she felt it to be _____ .
record.explanation: Answer C: outmoded. “Outmoded” means no longer current or fashionable, which explains refusal to wear the dress. Independent check: “Outmoded” means no longer fashionable or current, matching the dress. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/outmoded.
